Name: lluviann's Horns and Cat Ears
Author: lluviann
Description:
- This mod currently adds new configurable cat ear options, suck as Grey, Pink, Lilac Dark Purple and Red.
- The cat ears and whiskers can be configured to mix and match or you can have no whiskers which is perfect for the 2 new horns this mod also adds!
- The horns also come in the same colour as the above cat ears and have two configurable options regular horns or ram horns.
- Configurable whiskers and colours using GMCM or Config.Json file
!! Mod is a wip and more will be added in the future, please leave suggestions!<3

DISCLAIMER - since i’ve had a few people pm me and comment here i’m here to elaborate these DO NOT add new cat ears and horns to the game and they’re all configurable options for the cat ears, please configure this in config.json or use GenericModConfigMenu to choose if you want cat ears/horns and their colour as required for the mod, Thank you and enjoy!

Manifest.Name: lluviann's Horns and Cat Ears
Manifest.Description: Adds horns and more colour options for cat ears!
